title: Evaluation After Rewiring
statement: Let $N$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $N$ inputs, and let $\text{srcs}$ be a list of $N$ vertex indices, each less than $k+2$. The circuit $C$ is assumed to have gates in topological order, each reading only earlier vertices, and a valid output vertex. For every assignment $x$ to $k$ bits, the rewired circuit's output equals the output of $C$ when its $i$th input is taken from the list consisting of $x$ followed by $0,1$, at index $\text{srcs}[i]$.
hypotheses_covered: Every source index is less than $k+2$
$C$ has gates in topological order with each gate reading only earlier vertices
$x$ is an assignment to the $k$ bits
